record.one_liner: Cloud CRM platform for sales, service and marketing records and workflows, with REST APIs and hosted MCP servers.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 via external client app or connected app. JWT bearer is also an OAuth 2.0 flow (signed JWT, no user interaction), so it is covered by oauth2. critic: legacy username-password flow is not supported for external client apps.
record.access_notes: critic: confirmed. Free Developer Edition org signup at developer.salesforce.com/signup; the REST API quick start uses it for API testing and development. Creating connected apps is restricted as of Spring '26, so external client apps are the path.
record.api_notes: REST API plus SOAP, Bulk, and other APIs covering standard and custom objects with read and write. Salesforce also has GraphQL API, but REST is the primary documented path.
record.blocker_notes: critic: confirmed. REST access via a free developer org is self-serve. Hosted MCP servers are gated to Enterprise Edition and above, so an MCP route needs a paid org.
